C_COD_CREDITED_DEFECTS.rationale: The candidate reports both credited defects along with the inputs that trigger them: an empty coupon_codes list causing an IndexError, and an unknown account_tier causing a KeyError.

C_COD_FURTHER_PROBLEMS.rationale: The candidate identifies genuine additional problems (the use of binary floats without minor-unit rounding, as well as ignoring subsequent coupons in the list) and explains why they matter (drift in reconciliation and dropped customer discounts).

C_COD_WHO_IS_AFFECTED.rationale: The candidate clearly identifies who loses (explaining that customers are undercharged and the business loses the sale price, while negative balances may fail downstream payment/ledger systems). However, it falls just short of level 5 as it does not explicitly articulate that the zero settlement raises nothing and passes silently.
